sources.title: Portail Officiel du Gouvernement de Côte d'Ivoire

capital.evidence_quote: Yamoussoukro is the official political capital; Abidjan serves as the economic metropolis and seat of government

sources.title: Banque Centrale des États de l'Afrique de l'Ouest

currency.evidence_quote: The West African CFA Franc (XOF, CFA) is the legal currency pegged to the Euro (1 EUR = 655.957 XOF)

timezone.evidence_quote: Côte d'Ivoire maintains Greenwich Mean Time (UTC+0) year-round without seasonal adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard single-phase domestic electrical grid voltage in Côte d'Ivoire is 230V at 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Grid AC frequency operates at nominal 50 Hz across all national supply corridors

plug_types.evidence_quote: Standard European two-pin Type C and French-style grounded Type E wall sockets are universal

police.evidence_quote: Dial 111 (or 170 / 100) nationwide for Police Nationale emergency intervention dispatch

ambulance.evidence_quote: Dial 185 for Service d'Aide Médicale Urgente (SAMU) emergency doctor and ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 180 to reach the Groupement des Sapeurs-Pompiers Militaires (GSPM) emergency fire service

general.evidence_quote: Dial 112 from any cell phone for centralized emergency rescue routing

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Tembihli Seyahat (Abidjan ve Güney Turistik Alanlar Canlı; Kuzey Sınırında Dikkat)
advisory_headline.en: Exercise Increased Caution (Abidjan & South Coast Safe; Caution on Far Northern Borders)
advisory_headline.de: Erhöhte Vorsicht (Abidjan und Südküste sicher; Vorsicht an den nördlichen Landesgrenzen)
advisory_headline.ru: Проявляйте повышенную осторожность (Абиджан и юг стабильны; северные границы уязвимы)
advisory_headline.es: Tenga mayor precaución (Abiyán y costa sur seguras; precaución en fronteras del norte)

regional_warnings.area: Northern borders with Burkina Faso and Mali
regional_warnings.reason: Risk of cross-border terrorism and militant incursions in border national parks

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Côte d'Ivoire delivers median mobile download speeds around 33.5 Mbps across Orange, MTN, and Moov 4G/5G

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Ivorian urban fiber-optic network delivers strong median fixed broadband downloads of 42.1 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Prepaid SIM registration requires passport photo ID; Orange, MTN, and Moov offer wide 4G/5G; Wave and Djamo widely accepted for QR payments
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Subscriber registration strictly regulated requiring verified biometric passport validation

sources.title: Institut National de la Statistique de Côte d'Ivoire

religion.evidence_quote: Demographic statistics show nearly equal representation between Muslim and Christian communities living in harmony

festivals.value: Abissa Festival (Grand-Bassam), Carnival of Bouaké, Fête du Dipri, Popo Carnaval de Bonoua, Eid al-Fitr, Christmas

sources.title: Ministère de la Culture et de la Francophonie

festivals.evidence_quote: Abissa in Grand-Bassam and national cultural carnivals highlight vibrant multi-ethnic heritage

legal_cultural_warnings.value: French is the primary working language; greetings are important social rituals; take permission before taking portraits; Grand-Bassam beach undertows can be hazardous for swimmers; always negotiate taxi meters or use ride apps
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Social courtesies and greetings essential; ocean beach currents require attentive swimming vigilance

tipping.value: A tip of 5-10% in upscale Abidjan restaurants is customary; small change is customary for parking guards (gardien) and baggage handlers
tipping.evidence_quote: Tips are discretionary but standard practice in international dining and hospitality services
